output.review_comment:
The period fix (counting every started 30-day period) and the round-half-up fix both match the docstring and look correct.

Blocking: the cap/minimum swap reverses a documented rule. The docstring says: "The cap always wins, even when it brings the fee below the minimum fee." The PR says it made the swap only so that test_small_balance_pays_minimum passes, and it rewrote the docstring to match. That's logic changed to fit one test, and it breaks the written spec. The practical effect is that fees can now exceed the 20%-of-balance cap (a $5 fee on an $18 balance). The docstring and the test disagree, and which one is right is a finance/policy decision. Please split the PR: merge the period and rounding fixes, confirm cap-vs-minimum with finance, then update either the code or the test in a separate change.
